metadata.description: Real degree and professional programme categories offered by recognised institutions; availability varies by institution.
metadata.verificationPolicy: Verify time-sensitive details on the linked official source before relying on them.
notes: Typical durations are general programme conventions, not a substitute for the current institution-specific regulations.
A programme category does not confirm that a specific institution offers the programme or holds current approval.
Professional, clinical, aviation, maritime, teacher-education and other regulated programmes may have additional eligibility, internship, licensing or regulator requirements.
Reference URLs are regulator or official-sector starting points and should be checked for current relevance before production use.
